title: Mobile data not working: connection checklist
content:
Symptoms: Mobile data is switched on but apps and websites do not load, while calls may still work.
Resolution steps:
1. Verify that mobile data is enabled on the device and that airplane mode is off.
2. Confirm the device has network service (signal bars shown).
3. Check that the data balance or plan allowance is available through the approved account view.
4. Restart the device and retry the data connection.
5. Collect the device model, location and time of the failure and escalate if data remains unavailable.
Escalate when: Data remains unavailable after restart with network service present.
Caution: Do not change APN or network settings that are not listed in this article.

title: Evening broadband drops: time-pattern diagnostic
content:
Symptoms: Broadband drops repeatedly at a similar time of day, often in the evening, even after the router has been restarted.
Resolution steps:
1. Record the exact times the drops occur over several days.
2. Check whether the router/ONT status lights change when the connection drops.
3. Test whether a wired device drops at the same time as Wi-Fi devices.
4. If the customer has already restarted the router, do not repeat the restart; move to the line test request.
5. Request a line test through the approved support process and attach the recorded time pattern.
Escalate when: Drops continue at a repeating time after the router restart, or the customer relies on the service for work.
